== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Wookiee Warrior (Errata 2)]]: Left: the image of [[Wookiee Warrior (Errata)]] (published 1 June 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable e8445f0]); right: the image of [[Wookiee Warrior (Errata 2)]] (published 30 December 2024, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/wookieewarrior.gif holotable 9d2c01e]). Same area (x 133–717, y 709–1039) cropped from each published image <code>wookieewarrior.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
